# Reloceans

> Reloceans is an English-language awareness project about the sea creatures of the Mediterranean. In short videos and posts, the animals tell their own stories, and every fact they share is sourced on reloceans.com. Each story ends with one small thing people can do to help.

## The crew
- Carla, a loggerhead sea turtle (Caretta caretta): dark nesting beaches, plastic in the sea
- Mo, a Mediterranean monk seal (Monachus monachus): giving seals space, not entering sea caves
- Finn, a bottlenose dolphin (Tursiops truncatus): slowing boats near dolphins
- Pip, a long-snouted seahorse (Hippocampus guttulatus): anchoring on sand, protecting Posidonia seagrass
- Ollie, a common octopus (Octopus vulgaris): reporting ghost nets
- Gus, a dusky grouper (Epinephelus marginatus): not buying grouper or undersized fish

## How we work
- The characters are AI-animated, and every post is labelled as AI-made. The facts are checked and linked to their sources.
- New short videos are published on Instagram, TikTok and YouTube.
- A shop of digital stickers, wallpapers and illustrated guides is planned. Part of every sale will go to marine conservation, and we will publish where it goes.
